'''Fhost''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which was close to the edge of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Mostly covered by deserts, mountains, and a single [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], Fhost had its beauty. The largest population center, [[Farpoint]], was built on the remains of a [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] that crashed there long before [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Fhost was so far out from the main [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] that all [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] shows that were available were at least four months old.
